An attacker can control the resource name in Heat, which can be used as the URL (via a column's link callable) to inject a javascript: URL, leading to XSS when the link is clicked.

audit_raw.title: XSS via unescaped email in admin groups table
audit_raw.verdict_reason: The change removed the HTML escaping filter (defaultfilters.escape) from the email column in the UsersTable, allowing an attacker to inject JavaScript via their email attribute. The email is rendered in the table cell without escaping, leading to XSS when viewed by an admin.

audit_raw.title: XSS via unescaped email in admin users table
audit_raw.verdict_reason: The diff shows the removal of the escape filter from the email column's filters, leaving only default_if_none and urlize. Without escaping, attacker-controlled email containing HTML/JavaScript is rendered unchanged, leading to XSS when an admin views the users table.
